sn5.1:1.1: This chapter naturally follows the previous, as it features Māra challenging various bhikkhunīs. Most of these verses are also included in the Therīgāthā, without the prose narrative.
sn5.1:1.3: Her name means “of Āḷavī”. These verses are included in [thig3.7](), where the author is named Selā. The commentary confirms that she is the same person, Selā of Āḷavī.
sn5.1:1.4: Normally one goes “for the day’s meditation” (_divāvihārāya_), whereas here, uniquely, the text has “seeking seclusion” (_vivekatthinī_). In line with this, the next sentence has Māra wanting her to “fall away from seclusion”, whereas normally it is “fall away from immersion”. Seclusion also occurs in Māra’s challenge.
